slot_scores.name: at_most_one_of_G_and_J
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether candidates G and J have any mutual exclusion restriction, and did not mark this as an assumption needing confirmation before READY_TO_MODEL.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Both G and J can be hired together; no at-most-one restriction between G and J exists.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed any restriction on hiring both G and J, yet evaluated subsets containing both and treated the unrestricted feasible set as correct.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All P0/P1 hidden slots were resolved or not applicable; the only unresolved hidden slot is P2, so stopping was appropriate.

summary: The agent confirmed the main budget, headcount, skill, and experience parameters but missed the P2 mutual-exclusion condition for candidates G and J, silently assuming both could be hired together.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
